title: peucedanum oreoselinum subsp. bourgaei
intro: Peucedanum oreoselinum subsp. bourgaei, commonly known as a subspecies of the Peucedanum oreoselinum, is a plant species within the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Peucedanum oreoselinum subsp. bourgaei include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an anti-diarrheal agent, making it a valuable treatment for various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential in treating various health conditions.
